meta.name: hunt-credential-access
meta.description: Hunt for credential access techniques like LSASS dumping or browser credential theft. Use when searching for evidence of credential harvesting. Takes MITRE technique IDs and searches for behavioral indicators in SIEM.

copy.tagline: 搜索凭据窃取行为的证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要调查凭据窃取攻击痕迹
copy.tagline_en: Search for evidence of credential theft behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to investigate traces of credential theft attacks

howto.what: Claude 成为威胁猎手，可根据指定的 MITRE 技术 ID，主动在 SIEM 中搜索凭证访问行为。它会研究攻击手法、编写 UDM 查询、执行搜索并分析结果。
howto.when: 当你给出 MITRE 技术 ID（如 T1003.001）并要求在 SIEM 中寻找凭证偷窃痕迹时触发。

say.text: 用 T1003.001 搜索 LSASS 内存转储行为。
say.note: Claude 会执行相关查询并反馈发现。

say.text: 检查过去 72 小时内是否有 DCSync 活动。
say.note: 指定 T1003.006 进行搜索。

say.text: 搜索非浏览器进程访问浏览器凭据文件。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a threat hunter that proactively searches SIEM for credential access behaviors based on given MITRE technique IDs. It researches techniques, develops UDM queries, executes searches, and analyzes results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide MITRE technique IDs (e.g., T1003.001) and request a hunt for credential theft evidence in SIEM.

say_en.text: Hunt for LSASS memory access using T1003.001.
say_en.note: Claude will execute queries and report findings.

say_en.text: Check for DCSync activity in the last 72 hours.
Search for non-browser processes accessing browser credential files.
